references.reason: The complete linked Samguk sagi 18 annals of Gogugwon were rechecked. Gogugwon succeeds in Micheon's 32nd year, and the annals list 九年，燕王皝來侵，兵及新城。王乞盟，乃還 and then a separate entry, 十年，王遣世子，朝於燕王皝, which matches the excerpt. The Western years 339 and 340 depend on the 331 accession synchronization and are not printed in the source. The near-identical campaign wording is not proof of independence or of direction.

The complete linked Haedong yeoksa 6 was rechecked. Under 成帝咸和六年 it records 弗利死釗代立 and cites the Korean history (東史) for the 331 accession. Under 三年 (Xiankang) it has the interlinear note 通鑑作五年○故國原王七年, the text 燕王皝伐高句驪…明年遣其世子朝於皝, and the tag 晉書. It is a later Joseon arrangement of the Jinshu passage, rightly treated as a competing reading and not as independent testimony.

The complete linked Tongjian 96 was rechecked. The Goguryeo campaign and Zhao's request for a covenant fall in the Xiankang 5 (339) section. Yu Liang's death (正月庚子朔) heads Xiankang 6 (340). The 乙卯 recognition of Huang as King of Yan, with Jun made 世子, falls in Xiankang 7 (341). Nowhere in the volume is there an express entry for Goguryeo heir homage, which supports the note's distinction between that and an inference.
